title: Non-Realizability version of the S-1 / fork-A criterion (design note)
layer: mechanism-hypothesis / identifiability instrument (analysis-only, paper, no run)
route_disposition: fork-A-as-subject-separation -> CLOSED_BY_BOUNDED_ANALYSIS (recommended), pending a Section-5 symmetry-breaker; fork B continues

collapse.horn_A: s*_G exists but intractable -> K-A1a caps + non-realizability = compute/sample gap = S-2 -> CAPABILITY_NOT_SUBJECT -> fork B
collapse.horn_B: no fixed s*_G -> nothing to score a shortfall against -> UNMEASURABLE_NOT_FALSIFIABLE / SPECIFICATION_GAP
collapse.strongest_patch: diagonal/self-referential non-amortizability -> equal-access forces embedding every baseline -> same self-referential position -> MECHANISM_FAMILY_REPLICATION; self-reference is a property of being-embedded, grantable, not M-specific (or else circular)

root_obstruction: equal access is symmetric under BOTH compute-scaling and embedding; any constructible non-amortizability collapses into a capability gap or a mechanism-family property
reopen_hook_ONLY: exhibit an access asymmetry that is simultaneously (i) not compute-closable, (ii) not grantable to an equal-access embedded baseline, (iii) still measurable. Status: UNKNOWN / none constructed; appears near-contradictory without smuggling subjecthood or losing measurability
minimal_falsifier: bounded paper design sweep: name ONE G that is measurable AND has provably no amortizable dominating reference AND whose M-edge is diagnosably neither tractability nor embeddedness. None within budget -> route CLOSED_BY_BOUNDED_ANALYSIS; one -> POTENTIAL_SURVIVOR -> mandatory hostile re-audit
